title: Surya
brief_description: A sculpture in stone of Surya.
detailed_description: Richly embllished standing image of Suryadeva (sungod) flanked by attendants- danda and pingala. The two handed deity holds full blown lotuses in both the hands; the image is depicted with heavy ornamentation - kiritha mukutha, karnakundala, necklaces, chest ornamentation, katibanda (waist band). The deity wears boot till the knees- probably the influence of kushana art. The personification of Surya and his worship as a deity with other deities like Shiva, Vishnu, Shakti and Ganesha became popular in India from the Gupta period. Surya had been worshipped as a deity from ancient times by the Hindu populations of Goa region.
